card-row-compact.looks: A row of small white cards: an icon, a title, a short description and an optional text link.
card-row-compact.use: Linking to three to six related topics or data pages.
card-row-compact.avoid: Cards that need a paragraph or a button: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.columns: Cards per row, 1 to 6; empty keeps 4.
fields.alignment: left (default), center or right for everything in the cards.

fields.icon: A small icon; tinted with iconColor, or shown as is when that is empty.
fields.title: A few words.
